doc.title: Jerry Hey interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 2, 2023

title: Current projects
summary: Hey does about a project a month, including horns for a movie with Pharrell songs, with his son as engineer.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: Nice. Happy to hear that. I’ll just wrap up with a question about what’s coming up for you?

I have a few things here and there, not a lot, and I’m okay with that. But you know I’ll do kind of a project sort of, a month, and guys will call me up — we just finished a project from a guy from Germany who flew over to do the horns on three tunes. And we have a movie coming up that my son works for Harvey Mason Jr. if you know of Harvey Mason Sr., the drummer, his son is a big time producer and working on movies mostly now. My son works for him as his engineer and they’re doing a movie that Pharrell has some songs in that we’re going to play some horns on maybe next week. So you know a few things here and there, and I’ve got a couple kind of pending projects. But a project a month is kind of good.
